## What changed

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues with `Fixes #123` when appropriate.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and their results. Name the operating systems you actually tested.
For UI changes, include a screenshot with synthetic content. Remove personal messages and network details.

## Release note

Write a short user-facing note, or explain why this change needs no release note.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change stays within the linked issue or described scope.
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation are updated.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or generated build output are included.
- [ ] Platform limitations and untested behavior are stated above.
